# Shanios Wiki

> Technical documentation for Shanios — the immutable Linux OS with atomic blue-green updates, Btrfs subvolumes, and Secure Boot. This is a single-page wiki: every section below is an anchor on the same page, not a separate URL.

All content lives at https://wiki.shani.dev/ — the sections below are `#anchor` locations within that one page.

## Sections

- [Overview](https://wiki.shani.dev/#overview): What Shanios is, its release channel, and the five core ideas behind how it works.
- [Introduction](https://wiki.shani.dev/#getting-started): What is Shanios, migrating from a traditional Linux distro, and what ships out of the box.
- [Concepts](https://wiki.shani.dev/#concepts): Atomic updates, blue-green deployment, immutability, and persistence.
- [Installation](https://wiki.shani.dev/#installation): Requirements, pre-install steps, the install process, and first boot.
- [Architecture](https://wiki.shani.dev/#architecture): Boot process, Btrfs subvolume layout, the build pipeline, dracut module, filesystem structure, and overlay filesystem.
- [Security](https://wiki.shani.dev/#security): AppArmor, Secure Boot, TPM2, keyring, LUKS encryption, permissions, and hardening.
- [Updates & Config](https://wiki.shani.dev/#daily-use): Update channels, configuration, shani-health, shani-reset, and shell/user setup.
- [Software & Apps](https://wiki.shani.dev/#software): Flatpak, containers, gaming, development tools, and package management.
- [Networking](https://wiki.shani.dev/#webhosting): Native networking services and self-hosted networking stacks.
- [Troubleshooting](https://wiki.shani.dev/#troubleshooting): Common problems and how to diagnose them.
- [FAQ](https://wiki.shani.dev/#faq): Frequently asked questions.
- [Glossary](https://wiki.shani.dev/#glossary): Terminology reference.
- [Contribute](https://wiki.shani.dev/#contribute): How to contribute to Shanios and this wiki.
